note.kid: Inside the big network a quick sticker says which motorway to take, so nobody has to read the address.
note.nerd: Label-switched through the core: the label is swapped at every LSR and popped at the edge (the border router, or the hop before it with penultimate-hop popping).

label.about: Chosen by the next router for this path: it switches on the label without reading the IP address.

s.name: Bottom of stack
s.about: 1 = the last label; an IP packet follows.

ttl.name: TTL
ttl.about: Copied from the IP TTL when the label goes on and counted down by every label-switching router; when the label comes off, it’s copied back into the IP header (the uniform model).
